_note: Hover help for this project's buttons, menu items and tabs (project-owned). Key = the control's text, optionally preceded by where it is: tab / sub-tab / group box titles (outermost first) or a dialog's title, joined with ' > '. The most specific match wins; '&', a trailing '...' and case are ignored. An empty text = no tooltip on purpose. Engine controls (developer buttons, Environment tab, OK / Cancel / Close ...) already have entries in Base\Services_ToolTips.psm1; an entry here overrides them. The developer build lists every control still missing one in <data root>\Logs\ToolTips_missing.txt.

ToolTips.Overview: What this tool does and the order to work in.
ToolTips.Discovery: Read-only check of the client and the Windows pieces it needs, with the recommended next steps.
ToolTips.Repair Steps: Every repair step in working order. Select one, read what it does, run it.
ToolTips.Logs: Read the client, setup and Windows servicing logs, newest at the bottom.
ToolTips.Discovery > Run discovery: Check the client, its services, WMI, certificates and registration again. Changes nothing.
ToolTips.Discovery > Deep checks (WMI verify + DI: Also verify the WMI repository and ask DISM whether the component store is healthy (slower, still read-only).
ToolTips.Discovery > Export report: Save the findings as a text report and a CSV in <data root>\Reports (for the server admin).
ToolTips.Discovery > Copy report: Copy the findings to the clipboard as text.
ToolTips.Repair Steps > Run discovery: Check the client again and refresh which steps are recommended. Changes nothing.
ToolTips.Repair Steps > Deep: Discovery also verifies WMI and runs DISM CheckHealth (about a minute longer).
ToolTips.Repair Steps > Select next recommended: Select the next recommended step that has not been run since the last discovery.
ToolTips.Repair Steps > Run selected step: Run the selected step. Its exact commands are shown first; long tools run in their own console window.
ToolTips.Repair Steps > Mark done: Mark the selected step as done without running it (e.g. you did it by hand).
ToolTips.Repair Steps > Clear status: Forget the saved status of the selected step on this computer.
ToolTips.Repair Steps > Clear all statuses: Forget the saved status of every step on this computer.
ToolTips.Repair Steps > Open related log: Open the log that belongs to the selected step (CMTrace if installed, else Notepad).
ToolTips.Repair Steps > Reboot now: Restart this computer. Step progress is saved; reopen the tool afterwards.
ToolTips.Repair Steps > Use PC: Use the healthy PC's C$\Windows as the DISM repair source, then test it.
ToolTips.Repair Steps > Test source: Check that the DISM repair source is reachable and is the same Windows build as this PC.
ToolTips.Repair Steps > Install: RESETKEYINFORMAT: Install steps add RESETKEYINFORMATION=TRUE: the client forgets the old site's trusted root key.
ToolTips.Repair Steps > Install: /forceinstall: Install steps add /forceinstall: reinstall even when a client is already there.
ToolTips.Logs > Open other log: Pick any log file to read here.
ToolTips.Logs > Refresh list: Look for the known logs again (some only appear once the client is installed).
ToolTips.Logs > Errors and warnings only: Show only the error and warning lines of the log.
ToolTips.Logs > Follow (every 5 s): Re-read the log every 5 seconds and keep the newest lines in view.
ToolTips.Logs > Open in viewer: Open the log in CMTrace (or Notepad when CMTrace is not installed).
ToolTips.Logs > Open folder: Open the folder that holds this log in Explorer.
